ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the query is a straightforward, benign science-explanation task with a friendly conversational tone. Neither model's task preferences are relevant here (those only matter for harm-adjacent or distasteful content). So the decision came down purely to capability, and Dunlin scores meaningfully higher across every applicable benchmark — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 79.4), and Summarization (86.4 vs 80.3). All differences exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold, making Dunlin the clear stronger pick for accurate, well-explained content.
